extraction.Name: Mekeh Carpenter, Mother of Alma Carpenter, deceased
extraction.Cancelled: Do not know if patent has been cancelled.
extraction.Recorded patent: It was filed in the County by William Carpenter.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Land has not been sold or mortgaged.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Taxes were paid for year of 1927. No assessments have been refunded.
extraction.NOTES: Patent was delivered in person July 6, 1920. Mental condition is good, physical condition is fair, financial condition is fair. No contributions from Government, State or County. Has no one dependent upon her for support. Has not been defrauded of her property. Document is in Buffalo County, State of South Dakota. Subscribed and sworn before notary on a day in 1929.
